# glyhub <img src="man/figures/logo.png" align="right" height="138" alt="glyhub logo" />

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Lifecycle: experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)
[![R-universe version](https://glycoverse.r-universe.dev/glyhub/badges/version)](https://glycoverse.r-universe.dev/glyhub)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/glycoverse/glyhub/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/glycoverse/glyhub/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![Codecov test coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/glycoverse/glyhub/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/glycoverse/glyhub)
<!-- badges: end -->

glyhub collects glycomics and glycoproteomics data for the Glycoverse ecosystem,
using the [`GlycomicSE`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyexp/reference/GlycomicSE.html)
and [`GlycoproteomicSE`](https://glycoverse.github.io/glyexp/reference/GlycoproteomicSE.html) containers from
[glyexp](https://github.com/glycoverse/glyexp). The package is experimental.

## Available data

glyhub provides **97 released curated datasets** as `GlycomicSE` or `GlycoproteomicSE`
objects:

| Source | Datasets | Coverage |
|:---|---:|:---|
| GlycoPOST | 75 | 47 public projects covering released N- and O-glycans, glycosphingolipid-derived glycans, glycosaminoglycan disaccharides and glycopeptides. |
| CPTAC | 8 | N-glycoproteomics from eight cancer cohorts: CCRCC, COAD, HGSC, HNSCC, LSCC, LUAD, PDAC and UCEC. |
| PRIDE, jPOST, iProX and MassIVE | 14 | Published N- and O-glycoproteomics studies, including a human tissue atlas, mouse brain, cancer, DQGlyco and Glyco-DIA experiments. |

The development catalog also includes **additional locally staged review objects** from
verified literature sources. They preserve complete selected author
matrices, source scales and missing values. These entries have `storage = "staged"`
and no download URL; they require the maintainer's verified local cache and are
**not a new public data release**. Reproduction instructions are under their
accession directories in `data-raw/`.

Some signed author-processed matrices are staged as **source-only files** via
`glyhub_load(id, kind = "raw")`; here raw means source asset, not instrument-raw
intensity. Their original scales are retained without creating a curated SE or
performing an inverse transformation. See `?glyhub_literature_sources` for exact
samples, scales and provenance.

Use `glyhub_catalog()` to browse dataset identifiers, experiment and glycan types,
structure availability and quantification methods. Each dataset's help page
describes its biological system, experimental design, source tables, units and
limitations. Data are downloaded on demand from a versioned release and cached
locally; see the loading examples below.

Objects retain source feature annotations in `rowData`, measurement conditions
and observation labels in `colData`, and original numerical values and processing
records in metadata. Compatible GlycoPOST tables from the same study and glycan
class are combined using supported feature identities, with source-coverage masks
for unmeasured combinations. Structures are encoded only when supported by
explicit evidence; unresolved annotations remain uncertain. Inclusion may cover
only part of a study: GPST000602, for example, contains annotated peaks with
spectrum-specific feature identities rather than an aligned feature matrix.

**Abundance scales and missing-value rules depend on the source:**

- **GlycoPOST:** zero-valued abundances become `NA` in the assay. Original values
  and processing masks remain in metadata; glyhub adds no imputation or
  renormalization.
- **CPTAC:** assays contain `2^source_value`, while original log2 values remain
  in `metadata(x)$raw_abundance`. A source zero becomes 1; source missing values
  remain `NA`.
- **Other published studies:** source numerical values and zeros are retained,
  except for the documented `-1` to `NA` convention in
  `glyhub_MSV000089484_N_HCC`. Some source tables already contain normalization,
  imputation or feature selection, as documented in the dataset help.

Consult `?glyhub_data_conventions` and the dataset help before comparing assays.
`raw_abundance` preserves the selected source matrix and may itself contain
author-processed values. Source-data licenses and citation requirements are
recorded separately from the package's code license.

## Installation

The glyhub package is not a core glycoverse package.
You need to install it individually even if you have installed the meta-package [glycoverse](https://github.com/glycoverse/glycoverse).

You can install the latest release of glyhub from [r-universe](https://glycoverse.r-universe.dev/glyhub) (**recommended**):

```r
pak::repo_add(glycoverse = "https://glycoverse.r-universe.dev")
pak::pkg_install("glyhub")
```

Or from [GitHub](https://github.com/glycoverse/glyhub):

```r
pak::pkg_install("glycoverse/glyhub@*release")
```

Or install the development version (NOT recommended):

```r
pak::pkg_install("glycoverse/glyhub")
```

**Note:** Tips and troubleshooting for the meta-package [glycoverse](https://github.com/glycoverse/glycoverse)
are also applicable here: [Installation of glycoverse](https://github.com/glycoverse/glycoverse#installation).

The Glycoverse repository provides dependencies such as `glyexp`. `pak` also
resolves required Bioconductor packages for your R version.

## Example

The datasets are stored in the [Glyhub data release](https://github.com/glycoverse/glyhub/releases/tag/data-v0.1.0).
The package includes the catalog and loader code, with no bundled data objects.

```{r}
head(glyhub::glyhub_catalog()[, c("dataset", "source", "bytes")])
```

For curated objects, use either the common loader or the dataset's own function. Both share the same
verified cache and return the same object:

```r
x <- glyhub::glyhub_load("glyhub_CPTAC_CCRCC")
x <- glyhub::glyhub_CPTAC_CCRCC()

x <- glyhub::glyhub_GPST000738_N_B4GalT1()
x <- glyhub::glyhub_load("glyhub_GPST000738_N_B4GalT1", offline = TRUE)

# Original CPTAC source archive; returns a verified local file path.
raw_file <- glyhub::glyhub_CPTAC_CCRCC(kind = "raw")
# Equivalent: glyhub::glyhub_load("glyhub_CPTAC_CCRCC", kind = "raw")
```

### Literature ingestion audit (2026-10-22)

The [164-paper ledger](data-raw/literature-20261022/README.md) maps 47 locally staged curated objects and 36 original processed-source assets to 34 papers, separately from existing resources. These additions are not published release assets. Pending verification does not mean a study has no data, and a linked resource does not imply complete coverage of its paper.
